title: 눈 속의 사냥꾼
caption: The image is a painting of a winter landscape with a village in the background. The village is covered in snow and there are several houses and buildings scattered throughout the scene. The sky is blue and the mountains are covered in a blanket of snow. In the foreground, there are trees and bushes, and in the center of the image, there is a group of people and animals gathered around a lake. The people are dressed in warm clothing and some are carrying bags and other items. There are also a few birds flying in the sky. The overall mood of the painting is peaceful and serene.
